beats.label: What Bonn tested
beats.text: Adults with **metabolic syndrome** ate **300 g** of oatmeal a day for **2 days**, on about **half** their usual calories.

beats.label: What changed
beats.text: Their **LDL** fell about **10%,** more than a calorie-cut group with **no oats,** and it was still **noticeable** 6 weeks on.

beats.label: The everyday bowl
beats.text: **80 g** a day for **6 weeks,** no other changes? Only **modest** effects.

beats.label: Why oats?
beats.text: Gut **bacteria** turn oats into compounds that **may** help cholesterol. Still an **early** lead.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: Tiny trial, **17** per group, partly **industry-funded.** Not a swap for **meds,** and ask a doctor before **crash** diets.
Follow before you trust the next **breakfast** rule.
